text: Authentic Brands Group is the owner of the Sports Illustrated brand; Minute Media holds its publishing rights under a long-term partnership.
short: Sports Illustrated is owned by Authentic Brands Group

source.name: Authentic Brands Group press release, 'Minute Media Secures Sports Illustrated Publishing Rights in Transformational Deal with Authentic Brands Group'
source.quote: Authentic Brands Group (Authentic), a global brand platform and owner of Sports Illustrated, today announced a long-term partnership
